title: AL-Go Telemetry Enhancements: repository fork and hosting information
summary: AL-Go telemetry now captures whether a repository is a fork and its GitHub hosting type (GitHub.com, GHEC, or GHES), helping distinguish workflows across different environments without sending server details to telemetry.
key_points: New `Get-RepositoryIsFork` function determines fork status from workflow event metadata
New `Get-GitHubHostingType` function classifies GitHub hosting as GitHub.com, GHEC, or GHES
Telemetry dimensions include repository and hosting context for Microsoft and partner systems
Invalid or missing metadata produces warnings and returns 'Unknown' without blocking telemetry
Added 27 unit tests covering both PowerShell 7 and Windows PowerShell 5 compatibility
quote: Add repository and hosting context to AL-Go telemetry so consumers can distinguish workflows running in forks and across GitHub hosting environments.
